readme.summary: Private Rust/Bun monorepo: the Bun fork runtime (`yolo`), the Python runtime (`vu`), the `aphrody` CLI/MCP/FFI and the M3 UI framework.
layout: Build, product, host and deployment declarations
audit, build, dev, migration, release, tools
installation: Depuis ce clone privé, avec Codex installé et authentifié, lance une seule commande :

L’agent installe les produits publiés, les dépendances du poste, les plugins Aphrody/Yolo et le MCP canonique ; il configure Docker, les secrets montés et WASM, puis vérifie chaque composant. Les builds lourds passent par l’usine VPS. Avec un autre agent CLI, donne-lui directement [cette tâche d’installation](docs/operations/INSTALL-AGENT.md).
Le dépôt et GHCR sont privés : les accès GitHub et fournisseur IA doivent déjà être authentifiés. Les composants absents pour une cible restent signalés dans le résultat d’installation.
| CLI, runtime et plugins | [Téléchargements et installateurs](https://downloads.aphrody.com/) : release immuable et SHA-256 |
| API/MCP Docker et Alpine AMD64/ARM64 | [Runbook Docker](docs/operations/container/CONTAINER.md) : images GHCR privées et digests qualifiés |
| Navigateur/WASM | [Paquet CLI WASM](packages/infra/cli-wasm/README.md) : ESM et module WASM unique |

Les installateurs Windows ont été exécutés sous Wine ; l’application desktop complète, macOS et le SDK FFI intégré demandent encore une qualification sur leurs cibles. Les résultats et limites sont consignés dans les runbooks et [MEMORY.md](MEMORY.md).
74 paquets publiés et vérifiés sur npm, avec versions épinglées et contrôle npm avant installation. Depuis ce clone, dans un projet ayant son `package.json` :

Le [catalogue complet et les limites de qualification](docs/operations/bun-packages.md) couvre les 92 paquets distribuables. `--list` affiche les versions ; `--only @aphrody/qr,@aphrody/fuzzy` sélectionne des paquets. Les 18 paquets nécessitant encore des gates natifs ou d’intégration restent exclus de cette commande.

owners: Precompiled runtime and SDK (Bun fork + CLI, aliases `bun`, `vu`)
Sole owner of the `aphrody-rust` Python binding
`aphrody-kernel`: minimal TCB + subsystems; Linux/Asterinas/kernel32 provide the rest
targets: `aphrody` multicall binary (`crates/infra/aphrody`, `crates/infra/aphrody-command`); former tool names are links

`aphrody-command-wasm` (`crates/infra/aphrody-command-wasm`), exposed by `@aphrody/cli-wasm`: pure commands and RAG JSON/vector operations share one module, loader and linear memory. `@aphrody/rag-core/wasm` uses the same loader.

`aphrody-mcp` (`crates/ai/mcp`) is the only MCP server and hosts the kernel in process; `aphrody kernel mcp`, `yolo mcp` and `m3-mcp` are deprecated aliases (2026-10-07); `yolo tool` and the M3 `tool-host` are tool hosts, not servers
`vu` runtime (uv + ruff + PyO3 + shared CPython), plan in `docs/plans/vu/PLAN.md`
One package, `packages/infra/product`, one entrypoint and `Aphrody-Setup.exe`: installation, administration and creator modules; showcase folded into canonical app-ui.
contracts: Versioned SDK and C ABI: opaque handles, sized structs, ABI/capability negotiation, length-carrying buffers, allocator-side release, explicit errors, cancellation, threading and lifetime rules.
Internal Rust types and engine rlibs are not the application ABI; a standard extension builds without rebuilding engines.
Every context, operation and resource has an owner. Bounded queues, explicit saturation; stop and join workers before unload; respect UI and JS-object threads.
Permissions, origin and isolation are enforced natively. Remote pages get no implicit Bun/host privilege; cookies and profiles stay isolated.
Preserve unwind/recovery at real artifact boundaries; isolate work that can fault memory.
Bun keeps JSC/WebKit, Obscura supplies V8/headless; V8 stays until Obscura/JSC parity. Qualify DOM, GC, exceptions, promises, microtasks, modules, workers, timers, interrupts and teardown.
Keep API/CLI/permission identities, licences, provenance, features and lockfiles. Remove a replaced path in the batch that qualifies its replacement.
Engines build per version/target; refuse an incompatible ABI before any native call.
npm `@aphrody` is the only package channel outside the monorepo; `workspace:*` inside it.
queue: Fold thin crates/packages into their owner (gates: clippy `-D warnings`, scoped tests on the VPS); root layout aligned on Tauri `dev`, Obscura and Bun `main` (`crates/ packages/ docs/ scripts/ tools/ vendor/ assets/ examples/ bench/ test/ patches/`); absorb `apps/ config/ data/ bin/ m3/ plugins/ py/`
`aphrody-mcp` is the only MCP server; `yolo mcp`, `m3-mcp` and kernel MCP become aliases; same-purpose tools merged
Target in `docs/plans/os-kernel/PLAN.md` (Asterinas `ostd`/`kernel/{core,comps,libs}`, Linux subsystems); replace hand-made coreutils/Nushell by `uutils`, `eza`, `sudo-rs` or Bun Shell
Remove agent-delegating commands (agy, antigravity, hermes, notebooklm…) and every command needing another executable; add maintained crates from crates.io to shrink the build
Cross-build `aphrody-ffi` (profile `runtime`), package, enable the artifact in `tools/config/downloads.json`
Point `bun`/`yolo`/`vu` on PATH to the fork binary; Windows; embed `libaphrody_ffi`; `bun:ffi` binding
Verified artifact on a fresh machine without engine rebuild; install, upgrade, rollback
Windows installer for `aphrody-app`; real Windows run; rendering in the real CEF app
Restart `shenron-site`/`shenron-bot` after the release; measure `/api/chat`; verify the agent card
Finish `workspace/wip/infra-mcp-auth` (bearer, free port, `infra validate` fix), gate, rebase, push
Python/TS extractors and `scripts/audit/ai/graph-parity.ts`; Graphify stays the parity oracle
npm `@aphrody/*`, crates.io (316 crates: metadata, `publish = false`, path versions, 14 taken names), PyPI
Archive absorbed GitHub repos and integrated forks; deprecate absorbed npm packages; prune stale worktrees
`web:verify`, 4 `packages/engine/yolo` tests (`libaphrody_ffi` absent), `aphrody infra validate`, global typecheck
success: Changing a workflow, screen or integration does not rebuild engines.
A standard Rust extension builds against the light SDK.
Every native resource has an owner and a verified teardown; cancellation leaves no leak or dangling callback.
Page and extension rights are enforced natively.
Runtime and app compatibility, upgrade and rollback are qualified; heavy artifacts are precompiled per supported target.
Build, size and memory gains are measured separately; replaced paths are removed after qualification.
plan.receipts: Each closure cites revisions, target, commands, results, artifact and limits, and separates source, tests, packaging, installation and activation.

memory.intro: Dated evidence only. Decisions and queue live in PLAN.md; rules in AGENTS.md. History: `git log -- MEMORY.md`.

sections.title: Monorepo consolidation
rows: 13 thin crates folded into owners: gcs, shell → `aphrody-kernel`; ecosystem, summary, project-doc, exec-events, ai → `aphrody-command`; softraster, web-chromium, n2b-native, rag-ffi, python-ffi → `aphrody-ffi`; everything-sdk → `fsindex` (commits e8740a668, 3bb98f70b, 61438dd98). Clippy `-D warnings` clean; command 21, kernel 8, ffi 69+2, fsindex 26+1 tests passed on the VPS.
Dead code exposed by the folds was removed; Windows-only paths (`everything_sdk::win`, `chromium` cookies) are not compiled on Linux.
Target kernel architecture recorded from `aphrody git ingest` of Asterinas and the GitHub tree of Linux: `docs/plans/os-kernel/PLAN.md`.
Plan only; no folder regrouping done yet.

WSL crate folded into `aphrody-command/src/wsl`, preserving multicall identities. Missing sha2 and moved fixture paths corrected. VPS snapshot `95c1ec042163591d98b0ddb94cf6c66ea366c5f7`: scoped check, test and strict Clippy all-targets passed; command 95 tests and code-graph 33 unit + 2 oracle tests, 130 total, zero failures or ignored.
Linux factory gates; installed full CLI not rebuilt or activated by this integration. Windows WSL execution remains to qualify.

Owner-requested product fusion: top-level `apps/` and `m3/apps/` removed; setup/admin/creator in `@aphrody/product` 0.3.0, Rust CLI in `crates/infra/aphrody`, Yolo CLI/Forge in `packages/engine/{yolo,forge}`, downloads in Workspace, showcase in app-ui. Product 348 tests, Forge 28, downloads 18, showcase 18 + 3 DOM, bridge 6 and embedded configuration 7 passed; scoped TypeScript/lint and repository links passed. CLI Cargo check passed on the VPS; Windows installer compiled and started under Wine.

Rust test/Clippy and native desktop qualification are pending. Wine is not physical Windows; Omar remains offline. Private stores and concurrent feature work are preserved. No performance improvement is claimed.

Consolidated Bun capabilities: `@aphrody/messaging` implementation and test-DOM package removed; Discord messaging now belongs to `@aphrody/discord-kit/messaging`, shared test DOM to `scripts/test-dom.ts`, inference to `@aphrody/bun`, HTTP transport to `@aphrody/bun`, and paths to Workspace. Compatibility facades remain for published `@aphrody/inference`, `@aphrody/paths` and `@aphrody/http`. Discord 65 tests and Google 34 tests passed; Workspace typecheck, targeted package contracts (17 tests), frozen Bun lock and docs generation/check passed.

The full Workspace suite had 377 passes, 20 skips and 3 fixture timeouts in `build-factory-source`; its isolated rerun had 8 passes and 2 Git pack fixture failures. Services were not activated and no remote Drive writes were executed. Full source-level consolidation does not imply package publication or host deployment.

RAG WASM folded into the canonical aphrody-command-wasm adapter; the dedicated rag-wasm crate, glue declaration and generated output directory removed. @aphrody/rag-core/wasm loads the CLI module and shares its instance/linear memory; typed loader names retained. RAG 15 tests, CLI 8 tests (including native/WASM output parity), packaging 15 tests, scoped TypeScript/lint/format passed. VPS release WASM build, 3 Rust unit tests, strict Clippy and MSVC cross-check via cargo-xwin passed. Two module payloads (4,496,394 + 2,979,023 bytes) replaced by one 4,498,468-byte optimized module. Rebuilt native CLI snapshot f2d8480fe4ea fetched with verified SHA-256 e57f2c32184763672e4ae6ca565b2a8a68780f4b690ee62600c9f236d21cc946 and executed on WSL.

Raw rag-core wasm/* resource paths migrate to @aphrody/cli-wasm/wasm/*. Source, packaging fixtures and local artifacts qualified; package publication, real browser execution and native Windows execution remain open. Installed PATH CLI remains unchanged; parity uses the rebuilt debug CLI. Other monorepo consolidation work remains open.

Forge and plugin implementations absorbed into Yolo src/cli modules; published npm identities remain thin compatibility facades. Compiled Yolo executed Forge help/version/systemd unit and generated a 13-file plugin plus a working hook outside any checkout. 279 tracked declarations moved from config/ to tools/config with production, fixture, CI and Docker consumers migrated. 94 JSON files parse; 59 migration tests, 16 owner-path tests and 16 integration tests passed; Bun workspace contract and frozen lock passed. Canonical docs links: 2077 local links and 1822 code paths checked, zero broken/dead paths. Full Yolo script: 277 tests, 2789 assertions, zero failures, using qualified installed tooling library SHA-256 3212bfd18223e188e4cb2bc4bcd6ab4027a9359d522d5ba59d34c3e297789d3d (ABI tooling 1/n2b 2/oxc 1); TypeScript passed.

Protected backup remains in its existing store. No fork activation, public package update, native desktop app execution or full objective completion is implied. OS test/Clippy tracked separately; root layout gate still exposes unmigrated M3/Tauri workspace paths.

OS source layout consolidated as crates/os/ostd and kernel/{core,client,comps,libs}; 22 crate identities and 2117 tracked files retained, zero missing. Factory all-22 check 5afea21ab1b6 passed; tests 2ba687d91318: 943 passed, zero failed, three existing ignored, 59 suites. Strict all-target Clippy e1a7de359097 passed. Drive/A2A/inventory 13 Bun tests and docs-consolidation 28 tests; scoped TypeScript and formatting passed.

Independent FSL Drive workspace excluded and not compiled. Existing cross-component dependencies, Windows execution, SDK/runtime packaging and installation remain unqualified. No measured performance gain claimed. Concurrent local-jobs activation and crawler changes remain with their owners.

sections.title: Bun fork and absorption
rows: Contract `tools/config/bun-absorb.json` + ratchet `scripts/audit/workspace/bun-absorb.ts`; 50 dead catalog entries removed. Fork resolves `picocolors`, `tiny-invariant`, `dotenv`, `uuid` natively (670 differential assertions identical).
At that date no fork build; installed Bun was official 1.4.2.
`aphrody-labs/bun` has one branch, `main` (upstream + Aphrody fixes); monorepo branches merged and deleted, only `main` remains.
Fork keeps 12,458 inherited remote branches (not deleted).

`main` `41a2ff302d` (upstream `3f1765a6de`): factory build 546 s, 156 `first_party` tests green, Bun 1.4.3; libm symbols rewritten to glibc 2.39 (`packages/engine/forge/src/glibc.ts`), `elf-glibc-imports.ts --max 2.39` clean.
`/srv` on the factory was full; build ran with `BUN_FORGE_HOME` on the system disk.

Absorbed natively: `postgres`/`pg` → `Bun.SQL`, `vitest` → `bun:test`, `date-fns` → `Intl`, `fuse.js` → `@aphrody/fuzzy` (312 reference queries identical), `qrcode` → `@aphrody/qr` (208 symbols identical), `playwright-core` → `@aphrody/webview-page` (16 tests). Ratchet baseline `{}`.
No Kanji QR mode; fuzzy lacks extended search, logical queries, diacritic folding.
Single runtime `yolo` (fork `a4d88d124`: `argv0` aliases `bun`/`vu`, `dlopen(..., { global: true })`); `bun-forge --yolo-root` receipt green (569 s, 157 tests, sha256 `7c6b4c6e…5aa6`).
PATH links, Windows and embedded native tooling not activated.

Fork main `085dd0ad5e2356f805ecb1b5d51f7cc28da802af` built on the VPS with the Yolo CLI: 157 tests passed, 3 TODO; artifact 94,369,872 B, SHA-256 `0afedd2e225895f05b499340ce58d74b6925fe29d3d466f6601b8529ef11e510`, glibc max 2.38. Actual Bun → CPython → Rust smoke passed.
PATH/root vendor pin not activated; qualified embedded FFI parser SDK absent. No build-time or binary-size improvement claimed.

Windows `python-ffi` open.

Home sync is preview-first; `--apply` takes a verified backup.
